title: Molecular Partition Functions and Related Thermodynamic Data Are Extensively Tabulated
lead: Accurate partition functions of real molecules take corrections that simple models leave out, so the results are collected in tables. The JANAF tables are one such collection.
notes: The book prints no credits for this page.
exercise_notes: The book sets no exercise here; the one exercise is new and AI-written, with an AI solution checked by computation. Its Gibbs energy of formation of NH₃ is quoted from memory, not from the book.

exercises.source_id: equilibrium constant of formation expressed as a log value
exercises.prompt: A thermochemical table lists $\Delta_fG^\circ = -16.45$ kJ/mol for NH3(g) at 298.15 K. What value of $\log(K_f)$ should the same row list for the formation reaction ½N2(g) + 3/2H2(g) → NH3(g)?

footnotes.html: The standard state Gibbs energy of formation is $\Delta_fG^\circ$; the book repeats the symbol for the enthalpy of formation, $\Delta_fH^\circ$.
